```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
raw <- jsonlite::read_json(
  "data/wildfires.geojson",
  simplifyVector = FALSE
)

length(raw$features)
```

```{r}
first_fire <- raw$features[[1]]
print(names(first_fire))
raw$features[[1]]$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]]
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
fires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties) |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  mutate(
    lon = map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      ~ mean(map_dbl(.x[[1]], 1))
    ),
    lat = map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      ~ mean(map_dbl(.x[[1]], 2))
    )
  )
```

```{r}
top10 <- big_fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10)

m <- leaflet() |>
  addTiles()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(top10))) {
  m <- m |>
    addPolygons(
      lng = map_dbl(top10$geometry_coordinates[[i]][[1]], 1),
      lat = map_dbl(top10$geometry_coordinates[[i]][[1]], 2),
      color = "firebrick",
      fillOpacity = 0.5,
      weight = 1,
      popup = paste0(
        top10$incident[i],
        " (",
        top10$fire_year[i],
        "): ",
        scales::comma(top10$gis_acres[i]),
        " acres"
      )
    )
}

m |>
  setView(lng = -114, lat = 41, zoom = 5)
```
